hooks/memory/service.py:hooks.memory.ser.reason: Valid configured Bearer credentials contain no spaces. An accepted header therefore has exactly one separator and partition and rpartition yield identical scheme and token. With extra separators, rpartition yields a non-Bearer scheme while partition yields a token containing spaces that cannot match a valid configured Bearer credential. Both reject. Missing separators and empty tokens also reject. The mutant changes no observable behavior for valid configured Bearer credentials.
